name: VENTIQ Client 001 P2D Q2 FY27 Quarter-End Rehearsal
purpose: Deterministic quarter-end operating-close scenario proving that existing VENTIQ operating tables can reconcile fund NAV, portfolio value/cashflows, capital activity, expenses, investor positions, debt schedules, compliance, governance and investor-reporting readiness without introducing a new quarter-end accounting engine.

synthetic_fund.fund_name_prefix: VENTIQ CLIENT 001 SYNTHETIC Q2 FY27 CLOSE

draft_close.purpose: Prove quarter-end readiness is fail-closed while a close-required expense and compliance sign-off remain unresolved.

readiness_assertions: Draft close is NOT READY while the INR 50,000 administration expense is absent.
Draft close is NOT READY while the Q2 valuation sign-off is Pending.
The missing INR 50,000 expense explains the entire draft NAV reconciliation delta.
After the expense is recorded and compliance sign-off is Completed, validation blockers are zero.
Closing fund NAV equals opening NAV plus capital calls plus interest income plus valuation movement minus distributions minus fees/expenses.
Closing fund NAV also equals closing portfolio fair value plus closing cash.
Capital-call allocations equal the fund-level call and receipts equal allocations.
Distribution allocations equal the fund-level distribution.
Investor closing NAV values sum exactly to closing fund NAV.
Investor called capital plus uncalled capital equals commitment for each investor.
Debt schedule interest due equals cash received and is paid by quarter end.
governance_assertions: No quarter-close result is considered final while readiness blockers remain.
Once blockers are zero, the close evidence package may enter the existing central maker-checker workflow.
Final approval must occur before investor-reporting outputs are considered publishable.
The exact current approval action/link contract must be extracted from source before any live P2D rehearsal; P2D-2 does not invent a new approval action type.
output_assertions: A 30-Sep-2026 fund NAV snapshot records INR 29,500,000.
Closing investor position snapshots total INR 29,500,000: Investor A INR 11,800,000 and Investor B INR 17,700,000.
Closing capital called totals INR 28,000,000 and uncalled capital totals INR 22,000,000 against INR 50,000,000 commitments.
Portfolio closing fair value is INR 22,000,000 and quarter interest cash receipt is INR 800,000.
The debt schedule shows the Q2 interest item paid and the 15-Oct-2026 item not due at quarter close.
All quarter-close validation/compliance blockers are resolved before approval.
Approved close evidence retains source/audit lineage.
Investor documents/reporting remain governed by existing approval/publication controls.
p2d3_contract_extraction_required: Exact write payloads / required columns for the operating rows used in the rehearsal.
Exact current mechanism used to create or refresh fund_nav_snapshots and investor_position_snapshots.
Exact central approval action/link contract suitable for the close evidence package, without inventing a new action type.
Exact investor-reporting readiness/publication checks relevant after close approval.
Exact synthetic cleanup order for every P2D-created DB/storage/auth row.
cleanup_contract: Use a unique synthetic fund namespace.
Never mutate or delete any pre-existing fund or investor.
Delete only P2D-created operating rows, snapshots, approvals/audits, access/profile/auth rows and any storage objects.
If cleanup cannot be confirmed, stop all later mutating runs.
